name: mcp-clauses
description: A personal library of reusable contract and proposal clauses: 25 generic freelance starters with {{variables}}, ranked search, and one-call assembly into a real Word .docx with every missing fact left as a bracketed prompt. Everything stays on your machine.

license_key.title: License key
license_key.description: Optional Pro license key (format MCPL1.xxx.yyy). Leave blank to use the free tier.

tools.name: clause_add
tools.description: Save a reusable contract or proposal clause to the library. Returns the stored clause id, title, category, tags and the variables detected in its body, plus how many clauses of your own the library now holds.

tools.name: clause_get
tools.description: Return a clause in full by id or by title, with its variables and, in Pro, its revision count.

tools.name: clause_update
tools.description: Change the text, category, tags, variables or jurisdiction of a clause. In Pro the previous text is kept as a version; in the free tier the change is applied without history.

tools.name: clause_delete
tools.description: Remove a clause from the library. A deleted starter clause is not re-seeded on the next call.

tools.name: clause_list
tools.description: List every clause, newest categories first, optionally narrowed to one category.

tools.name: clause_search
tools.description: Ranked search over clause titles, tags, categories and bodies. Title and tag matches outrank body matches. Jurisdiction filtering is free; the tag filter is Pro and is skipped rather than refusing the search.

tools.name: clause_import
tools.description: Call this tool to bulk-load clauses into the library from a markdown or JSON file. Returns how many clauses were added, replaced, skipped and blocked by the free clause cap, plus the new library total.

tools.name: clause_export
tools.description: Call this tool to write the whole clause library out to one file. Returns the destination path, the format used and how many clauses were written.

tools.name: contract_assemble
tools.description: Call this tool to build a contract or proposal document from library clauses. Returns the path written, the clauses used in document order, which variables were filled, and the facts still missing as bracketed prompts.

tools.name: variables_list
tools.description: Given a set of clauses, list every {{variable}} they use and which clause uses it, so nothing is missed before assembling.

tools.name: license_status
tools.description: Show whether this server runs in free or Pro mode and where to upgrade.

tools.name: license_activate
tools.description: Activate a Pro license key (format MCPL1.xxx.yyy). Verified offline and saved locally.
